rhythm.method: Video system anchors plus checked meter; bounded bar-start spectral-flux refinement and interpolated eighths
rhythm.accuracy: Unlabelled estimate. Attack support is acoustical evidence, not timing accuracy or a verified bar phase.
limits: No pitch or note matching was used.
Video page turns have not been musically timestamp-checked.
Missing, held and offbeat sounds leave clock positions interpolated.
Dense subdivisions can support several phases; shifts stay below one fifth of an eighth.
The final video endpoint can include reverberation or silence.
Cross-pulse support checks withhold alternating pulses, but neither support metric is human timing accuracy.
